yotta-agent-hardening v0.2.7

- Added category field to SKILL.md for improved classification.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and related files.
- Minor adjustments and maintenance in install and script files.

- Bumped version to 0.2.6.
- Updated SKILL.md with new metadata fields (slug, displayName, summary, tags, homepage) and improved formatting.
- Refactored documentation for clarity and conciseness; adjusted section headers and command usage.
- Removed unused or redundant files: LICENSE, NOTICE, assets/banner.png, scripts/test_yotta_agent_hardening.py, skill-card.md.
- Maintained all core features: 三域静态加固扫描、防御守则生成、留痕与报告导出。

- 移除了 skill-card.md 文件，不再包含该说明文档。
- 其余功能、用法和守则均保持不变。

yotta-agent-hardening v0.2.4

- Updated references/report-template.md to refine hardening report templates and content structure.
- Minor text and markdown improvements in documentation files (SKILL.md, references/guardrails-template.md).
- Bumped version and dependencies in package.json.
- Small bug fixes and enhancements in scripts (test_yotta_agent_hardening.py, yotta_agent_hardening.py).
- Improved changelog maintenance (CHANGELOG.md updated).

yotta-agent-hardening 0.2.3

- 文档细节更新：优化开源声明和说明，明确能力开放不缩水
- 移除多余 skill-card.md 文件，保证文档简洁
- references 目录下相关模板文件内容/结构补充调整
- 清理和完善 SKILL.md 内容，信息更聚焦、表述更一致
- package.json 更新版本号及依赖同步

- Upgrade to version 0.2.2 with doc and template improvements.
- Updated and clarified documentation in SKILL.md, README.zh-CN.md, and reference files.
- Fine-tuned legal and usage scope descriptions for accuracy and clarity.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.
- Made various minor wording tweaks for clearer guidance on scan coverage and open-source terms.

yotta-agent-hardening 0.1.0 初始发布

- 发布元安全工具，为 AI 智能体 / Agent 提供环境安全体检与加固建议
- 三域扫描：提示注入防护、工具调用边界、数据隔离
- 支持扫描已安装 skills、MCP 服务器、工具描述与权限配置，输出合规性报告
- 提供可执行防御守则生成与文件校验，扫描留痕默认开启
- 零依赖，兼容 Python 3.8+，Windows/Linux/macOS 通用
- 开源免费，所有功能完全开放
